title: 中枢运动皮层重复经颅磁刺激联合小脑1 Hz刺激治疗小脑型多系统萎缩症的疗效及预测因素研究
originalTitle: Central motor cortical repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation at 5 Hz or 10 Hz combined with cerebellar 1 Hz stimulation for ataxia in multiple system atrophy of the cerebellar type: a retrospective cohort study of efficacy and predictors of response
summary: 本研究纳入48例确诊为小脑型多系统萎缩症（MSA-C）的患者，评估了不同频率（5 Hz和10 Hz）中枢运动皮层重复经颅磁刺激联合小脑1 Hz刺激的疗效及预测因素。

story.title: 王等公布rTMS联合小脑刺激改善MSA-C共济失调的探索性研究

author: Wang, M., Wang, Y., Wang, M., Han, Y., Pan, J., Zhou, Y.
